mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting river migration to the sheltered oasis made survival tangible: a route matters only if it leads to a suitable refuge.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting river migration yielded no available partners, leaving its eventual role unclear until the oasis appeared.

surprise.text: Advancing ice initially had no available combination when I tried it against the recovering world, but later worked with varied survivors to illustrate selection across generations.

arbitrary.text: Combining the sheltered oasis with cold-adapted populations felt somewhat abstract: it brought the routes together, but did not explain precisely how they formed surviving lineages.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the surviving lineages make of the newly open landscape; the distinct routes through the ice made that recovery interesting.
